newsitem.title: CAYMAN ISLANDS: Council appointed for Cayman stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Council appointed for Cayman stock exchange.

text.p: Eleven members have been appointed to two-year terms on the Council of the Cayman Islands Stock Exchange, the government announced Tuesday.

The council will be chaired by Anthony Travers, a senior partner with Maples & Calder Cayman Islands and a veteran of 20 years in the offshore financial industry in the British colony, said a statement from the Cayman Islands government press office in London.
The Cayman Islands Stock Exchange opened for business this month and was expected to list equity and debt securities of offshore mutual funds.
David Carrad was earlier appointed acting chief executive of the exchange.

Also named to the council were Deborah Drummond of the Caymans government; Nick Freeland of Price Waterhouse; Bryan Bothwell of Ansbacher; Jennifer Dilbert of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell; Barry Smith of Truman Bodden & Co.; Toy McTaggart of Peat Marwick;, Peter Larder of CIBC; William Roberts of WS Walker & Co.; Daniel Scott of Ernest & Young; and David Carrad.
